text: Mathlib4 Topology: In a topological space X, a subset U is open iff it is a neighborhood of each of its points. Mathlib formalizes topological spaces via topological fiber filters and neighborhood systems.

Hamiltonian Mechanics & Symplectic Geometry: Let (M, omega) be a symplectic manifold. The Hamiltonian vector field X_H associated with an energy functional H : M -> R satisfies i_{X_H} omega = -dH. In canonical Darboux coordinates (q^i, p_i), Hamilton's equations take the standard form dq^i/dt = dH/dp_i and dp_i/dt = -dH/dq^i.

Hilbert Space & Spectral Theory: Let H be a separable complex Hilbert space. A densely defined linear operator T with domain D(T) is self-adjoint if T = T*. By the Spectral Theorem, there exists a unique projection-valued measure E such that T = integral lambda dE(lambda).

Quantum Field Theory & Path Integral: The generating functional Z[J] of time-ordered Green functions is defined by the functional integral Z[J] = integral D[phi] exp(i/hbar * (S[phi] + integral d^4x J(x) phi(x))).
